title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 Q11: Triangle Above Square
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 第11题：三角形在正方形上

content.en: Five children each stacked a square, a triangle and a circle. The teacher removed all circles. How many piles have the triangle above the square?
content.zh: 五位孩子各把正方形、三角形、圆形纸片堆起来。老师拿走所有圆形后，有几堆是三角形在正方形之上？

explanation.en: After removing circles, 3 piles still have triangle above square.
explanation.zh: 拿走圆形后，仍有 3 堆三角形在正方形之上。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 Q12: Three Pieces Make Square
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 第12题：三片拼正方形

content.en: Which three of the five jigsaw pieces can be joined to form a square?
content.zh: 下列五片拼图中，哪三片可以拼成一个正方形？

explanation.en: Pieces 1, 3 and 5 fit together into a square.
explanation.zh: 第 1、3、5 片可拼成正方形。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 Q13: Shaded Cells Sum
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 第13题：涂黑格数字和

content.en: Each row and column of the table must contain 1, 2 and 3 exactly once. What is the sum of the numbers in the two shaded squares?
content.zh: 表格每行每列的 1、2、3 各出现一次。两个涂黑格子里的数字之和是多少？

explanation.en: Latin-square style filling forces the shaded cells to sum to 4.
explanation.zh: 每行每列 1–3 各一次，涂黑格之和为 4。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 Q14: Turn the Card Over
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 第14题：翻转卡片

content.en: After turning a card over around its right side we see the figure. What do we see if we turn it over around its upper side?
content.zh: 沿右边翻转卡片后看到图中一面。若沿上边翻转，会看到哪一面？

explanation.en: Turning over the top edge gives the figure in option D.
explanation.zh: 沿上边翻转后得到选项 D。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 Q15: Four Brothers’ Ages
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 第15题：四兄弟年龄和

content.en: Tim, Tom and Jim are triplets; Paul is exactly 3 years older. Which number can be the sum of the four brothers’ ages?
content.zh: Tim、Tom、Jim 是三胞胎，哥哥 Paul 正好大 3 岁。下列哪个可能是四兄弟年龄之和？

explanation.en: Ages: x,x,x,x+3 → sum 4x+3. Only 27=4×6+3 works among the options.
explanation.zh: 年龄和=4x+3；选项中只有 27=4×6+3 成立。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 Q16: Magic Trees Fruit
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 第16题：魔幻树的水果

content.en: Each magic tree has either 6 pears & 3 apples, or 8 pears & 4 apples. There are 25 apples. How many pears are there?
content.zh: 每棵魔幻树有 6 梨+3 苹果，或 8 梨+4 苹果。果园共 25 个苹果，有多少个梨？

explanation.en: Apples come in 3s and 4s totaling 25 ⇒ 3 type-A + 4 type-B trees; pears=3×6+4×8=50.

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 Q17: Cats Legs and Noses
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 第17题：猫的腿与鼻子

content.en: My cats have 18 more legs than noses. How many cats do I have?
content.zh: 我的猫腿的总数比鼻子总数多 18。我有多少只猫？

explanation.en: Each cat: 4 legs − 1 nose = 3 extra legs. 18÷3=6 cats.

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 Q18: Replace 201 with 102
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 第18题：把201换成102

content.en: Rachel adds seven numbers and gets 2016. One number is 201; she replaces it with 102. What answer does she get?
content.zh: Rachel 把七个数加得 2016，其中有一个 201。把 201 换成 102 后再加，得到什么？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 Q19: Breaking Brick Bars
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 第19题：切开砖条

content.en: Malte has a bar of 27 bricks. He repeatedly breaks a bar into two bars where one is twice the other. Which bar can he not get?
content.zh: Malte 有 27 块砖的砖条，反复切成一条是另一条两倍长的两段。他不可能得到下列哪段？

explanation.en: Breaks keep lengths that are multiples of powers of 3 from 27; E cannot appear.
explanation.zh: 每次按 2:1 切开，长度始终是 3 的方幂相关；E 不可能出现。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 Q20: Sparrows Chirping
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2016 – Level B -2 第20题：麻雀转头呼叫

content.en: Five sparrows chirp as many times as the sparrows they see. After one turns around, the total chirps increase. Which sparrow turned?
content.zh: 五只麻雀呼叫次数等于它看见的麻雀数。一只转头后，呼叫总数变多。是哪只转头了？

explanation.en: Only Bertha turning increases the total number of chirps.
explanation.zh: 只有 Bertha 转头会使呼叫总数增加。
